definitions.explanation: How well a blade or cutting tool cuts. The quality or degree of sharpness.
The sharpness or effectiveness of words, arguments, or actions. Used figuratively for things that are sharp and decisive.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{包丁|ほうちょう}→包丁：04976_houchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{切|き}れ{味|あじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: This kitchen knife has good sharpness.

examples.japanese: {切|き}れ{味|あじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧⟦ナイフ→ナイフ：01039_naifu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{研|と}いだ→研ぐ：04377_togu⟧。
examples.english: I sharpened the knife that had lost its edge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦はさみ→はさみ：00702_hasami⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{切|き}れ{味|あじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{抜群|ばつぐん}→抜群：12783_batsugun⟧だ。
examples.english: The new scissors have outstanding sharpness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{切|き}れ{味|あじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧。
examples.english: Her remarks are sharp and incisive.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦プレゼン→プレゼン：05505_purezen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{切|き}れ{味|あじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧だった。
examples.english: Today's presentation had sharp, incisive content.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねて→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{批評|ひひょう}→批評：03581_hihyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}れ{味|あじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{衰|おとろ}えない→衰える：04584_otoroeru⟧。
examples.english: Even as he ages, the sharpness of his criticism doesn't decline.

notes:
{切|き}れ{味|あじ} literally means 'cutting flavor' — the quality of how well something cuts. Widely used both for actual blades and figuratively for sharp wit, speech, or performance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {切|き}れ{味|あじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧/わるい: good/bad sharpness
- {切|き}れ{味|あじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧: extremely sharp
- {切|き}れ{味|あじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: to lose its edge
- {切|き}れ{味|あじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{抜群|ばつぐん}→抜群：12783_batsugun⟧: outstanding sharpness

USAGE:
The figurative sense applies to anything that is sharp and decisive:
- Speeches and arguments: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{批評|ひひょう}→批評：03581_hihyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}れ{味|あじ} (the sharpness of his criticism)
- Athletic moves: ⟦ドリブル→ドリブル：05927_doriburu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}れ{味|あじ} (sharpness of dribbling)
- Writing and wit: {切|き}れ{味|あじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧ (sharp, incisive writing)
